info.name: DevHub API
info.description:
Every DevHub endpoint with its happy path and edge cases, as one runnable flow.

Run it in order (Collection Runner or `npx newman run`) with the `DevHub - local` environment, against `./start.sh` (app + Postgres + Mailpit). Each run signs up a fresh random user; emailed codes are read from Mailpit's API automatically.

Every response is an ApiEnvelope: `{success, data | error, timestamp}`. Errors carry a stable `error.code`.

Rate limits are per IP and in memory. The last folder deliberately exhausts some of them, so restart the app before running the whole collection again.

item.name: 01 Signup
item.description: Account creation and every way it can be rejected.

item.name: 02 Email verification
item.description: Unverified accounts cannot log in. The code is read from Mailpit automatically.

item.name: Login - unverified account, wrong password (reveals nothing)
Verify email - unknown email (same error as wrong code)
Resend verification - on cooldown (202, no new email)
03 Login & sessions
item.description: One active session per account (last login wins) and single-use, rotating refresh tokens.

item.name: Login - with username in another case (second device)
Login - unknown account (same error as wrong password)
Refresh - reusing a rotated token ends the session
Refresh - newest token is revoked after reuse
04 Current user & security
item.description: GET /users/me and bearer token handling on protected routes.

item.name: 05 Logout
item.description: Logout is idempotent and never reveals anything.

item.name: Refresh - after logout (not reported as replaced)
06 Password reset
item.description: Reset code by email; a successful reset signs out every device.

item.name: Login - session that the reset must revoke
Login - old password no longer works
Refresh - session from before the reset is revoked
07 Devices & push
item.description: Push registration is bound to the session: when the session ends, the device stops receiving pushes.

item.name: Register device - same install updates in place
Logout - ends the session this device belongs to
08 Idempotency
item.description: Retries carrying the same Idempotency-Key replay the original result instead of running twice.

exec: pm.test("First run is not a replay", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Idempotent-Replayed")).to.be.undefined);

09 Rate limiting
item.description: Repeats one request until the per-IP limit answers 429. This uses up verify-email for your IP: restart the app (./start.sh resets the in-memory buckets) before running the collection again.

exec: pm.test("Tells the client when to retry", () => pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get("Retry-After"))).to.be.above(0));
